purpose: Map installed IDA plugins to reverse-engineering tasks. Inventory state is discovered at runtime; this file contains stable capability metadata only.

plugins.name: bindiff
plugins.use: Match functions and highlight changes between binary versions.

plugins.name: binexport
plugins.use: Export IDA analysis for BinDiff.

plugins.name: diaphora
plugins.use: Diff functions, CFG, pseudocode, types, comments and call graphs.

plugins.name: BinSync
plugins.use: Synchronize names, types, comments and structures across RE tools.

plugins.name: DeepExtract
plugins.use: Export PE metadata, decompilation, xrefs, strings and structural data for agents.

plugins.name: find-yara-x
plugins.use: Scan loaded IDA sections with YARA-X rules.

plugins.name: yarka
plugins.use: Manage and run YARA rules from IDA.

plugins.name: IDASignsrch
plugins.use: Find known crypto and library signatures.

plugins.name: aida
plugins.use: AI-assisted naming, comments and decompilation analysis; needs a configured provider.

plugins.name: gepetto
plugins.use: LLM-assisted pseudocode explanation and variable renaming; overlaps AIDA.

plugins.name: capa
plugins.use: Map binary behavior to CAPA rules.

plugins.name: idamagicstrings
plugins.use: Recover useful names from debug and source strings.

plugins.name: DriverBuddyReloaded
plugins.use: Assist Windows driver analysis.

plugins.name: EmuIt
plugins.use: Run Unicorn-backed local emulation for focused routines.

plugins.name: HappyIDA
plugins.use: Assist Rust string, parameter and exception analysis.

plugins.name: ApplyCalleeTypeEx
plugins.use: Propagate callee prototypes through indirect calls.

plugins.name: renimp
plugins.use: Rename dynamically resolved imports.

plugins.name: DBImporter
plugins.use: Import external analysis data into the IDB.

plugins.name: global-struct-dissector
plugins.use: Recover and inspect global structure usage.

plugins.name: ida-enums-helper
plugins.use: Speed enum and type annotation work.

plugins.name: ida-outliner
plugins.use: Navigate large IDBs by an outline view.

plugins.name: SigMaker
plugins.use: Create signatures from selected code.

plugins.name: Suture
plugins.use: Support controlled binary patch workflows.

plugins.name: ida-search
plugins.use: Improve IDB search and navigation.

plugins.name: deREferencing
plugins.use: Improve pointer/reference readability in pseudocode.

plugins.name: xray
plugins.use: Provide additional code navigation views.

plugins.name: hexinlay
plugins.use: Show useful byte and address context in the UI.

plugins.name: ida-cyberchef
plugins.use: Transform and decode selected data with CyberChef operations.

workflows.label: IDA + Agent 基线
workflows.selection: Use idalib-mcp for headless or MCP analysis; use GUI IDA when a plugin is GUI-only.

workflows.label: 单人版本差异
workflows.selection: Prefer BinDiff + BinExport for repeatable matching; use Diaphora for richer type, pseudocode and call-graph comparison.

workflows.label: YARA 与加密识别
gates: YARA rules or signature database available
workflows.selection: Use FindYaraX for arbitrary rules, Yarka for rule workflow, and IDASignsrch for known crypto/library signatures.

workflows.label: AI 伪代码解释
gates: AIDA/Gepetto provider or local model configured
workflows.selection: Configure one provider first; AIDA and Gepetto overlap and should not both be treated as required.

workflows.label: Agent 结构化数据
gates: local decompiler available for pseudocode export
workflows.selection: Use DeepExtract for SQLite/JSON/C++ exports and idalib-mcp for targeted follow-up queries.

workflows.label: Rust 二进制
gates: Rust project must declare idalib/SDK dependency for Rust-side analysis
workflows.selection: Use HappyIDA for Rust-specific readability and EmuIt for focused emulation; do not install Rust crates as IDA plugins.

workflows.label: Windows 驱动
workflows.selection: Use the driver helper first, then recover indirect calls and dynamic imports.
